scope: All 10 frozen UNKNOWN body fullforms only. Auxiliary punctuation and date are excluded. No values, key tables, decoded outputs, linguistic reports, or mark-value rules were consulted.
coordinate_convention: Half-open pixel-edge rectangles [x0,y0,x1,y1], original JPEG x right and y down. CW90/CCW90 use Pillow integer transpose; no resampling, filtering, inpainting, or mark removal.
eligibility_rule: Exactly one high-confidence definite base, one base candidate total, high base/mark/ownership confidence, a clear short rising stroke or two-armed V, no observed or unresolved cancellation/overwriting, and not an unmarked new shape. Passing geometry alone never changes a frozen primary token.

mark_category_definitions.acute_like_rising_stroke: One elongated short stroke whose upper end is generally rightward of its lower end; shape only.
mark_category_definitions.caron_V: Two visible oblique arms converge at an evident low vertex; shape only.
mark_category_definitions.ring: Closed or nearly closed detached outline surrounding a visible interior.
mark_category_definitions.dot: Compact detached point without a clear elongated stroke or surrounding outline.
mark_category_definitions.other: A definite observed auxiliary contour outside the listed geometries; its function may remain unknown.
mark_category_definitions.ambiguous: Competing categories or separations remain, including extra/retraced ink versus ordinary body or neighboring strokes.
mark_category_definitions.none: No separate auxiliary handwritten mark is observed; printed background is not a mark.
